Method of Attack: Exploitation of hardcoded password via SSH to gain full control and privilege escalation to root
Java deserialization attack allowing remote code execution as root without credentials
Impacted Systems: Cisco Prime Collaboration Provisioning (PCP) installed on Linux servers
Cisco Secure Access Control System (ACS) firewall system
Attack Vector: Local attacker connecting via SSH using hardcoded password; remote exploitation via network proxy
Deserialization of user-supplied Java serialized content
Date of Discovery: Reported in Cisco advisories on or before the date of the article (not explicitly stated)
